title: Downtown Luxury 3000 sq ft home
description:
Welcome to Music City's Downtown Hideaway! We invite you to experience our luxurious 3,000 square foot vacation home. 
Minutes away from Downtown Nashville, Lower Broadway, and much more. The open floor plan is great for groups up to 10 guests! 

This home holds three floors with a master bedroom with a king bed and on-suite full bath, as well as two additional bedrooms, each with a queen bed and a shared full bath. There is also a den with two queen size air mattress beds on the third floor.
